name: hud_line_clip_clip_endpoint_to_x
description: HudLineClip::ClipEndpointToX moves one segment endpoint to a requested X and linearly interpolates its Y coordinate.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation at 0x4bd9c0 have no warnings or tags and compute endpoint->y += (other->y - endpoint->y) * ((clipX - endpoint->x) / (other->x - endpoint->x)), then set endpoint->x to clipX.
The native line-clip smoke clips an endpoint from (0,0) toward (10,10) at X=5 and verifies the resulting (5,5).
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x4bd9c0 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
